coverage_assumption: Continuous collection over [start, end); occupied one-minute bins are availability, not sample completeness or equipment uptime.
aggregation_note: Minute means are diagnostic only; at least five finite readings per sensor are required. No interpolation; digital signals remain at native timestamps.
split_policy: February reference; March-May development; June through the recorded end held out. Report-free does not establish healthy operation. Full-timeline checks are restricted to structure and availability.
